widgets_values:
Neons Style Explorer

prompt    - your subject
quality   - quality prefix, always kept at the very front
negative  - your avoid terms

style / style_2 / style_3   the look (pick the dice to roll)
format / finish             optional extra axes
output_format               natural | danbooru | natural + danbooru
style_position              style clause at the start or the end
style_weight                1.0-5.0 emphasis on the style
roll_scope / roll_seed      how the dice picks (set the control under
                            roll_seed to randomize for a new roll each run)

Panel: Roll, Catalog, Save (stores the last generated image as this
style's preview), Edit, and a more menu. The composed prompt updates live.
